title: DNA Extraction
author: Stefania Konstantinidi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8cchssw
materials: The DNA is ready for amplification !

steps.title: Insert microneedle patch into leaf
steps.instruction: Place the microneedle patch between the leaf base and the midrib and apply pressure for a few seconds.

steps.title: Remove microneedle into dish
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the microneedle and place it in a petri dish.

steps.title: Add EB buffer and collect
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of EB buffer onto the microneedle patch with a pipette, then transfer the buffer containing DNA into a tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL EB buffer onto the patch using a pipette.
Transfer the EB buffer (and released DNA) into a tube.
